workload: Hellinger fidelity to the exact ideal distribution (Aer statevector). QPUTwin: its own compiler (SABRE on lattices), calibrated noise on the density-matrix engine, with and without idle-window decoherence. Aer: Qiskit transpile (optimization_level=1, seed 0) to the same native basis and coupling map, with the noise model in noise_models.py built from the identical calibration; 100 000 shots each
